tools.name: team.list

tools.name: website.list

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "website.save_draft" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: account.check_publishing, website.read, website.read_form_responses, website.read_version · Private data: website.publish, website.save_draft, website.read, website.list · Public sink: website.publish, website.read_form_responses · Destructive: account.check_publishing, website.read_form_responses.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: account.check_publishing, website.read, website.read_form_responses, website.read_version · Private data: website.publish, website.save_draft, website.read, website.list · Public sink: website.publish, website.read_form_responses · Destructive: account.check_publishing, website.read_form_responses

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
